entities.summary: Ye Li is a Chinese professional basketball player who played for the Shanghai Octopus of the Women's Chinese Basketball Association and the China women's national basketball team at the 2004 Summer Olympics. She also won a gold medal as part of the Chinese women's basketball team at the 2003 Summer Universiade.
